answer: This epoch the gate asks one thing only: Millwright corn meal milled at the mill house, and the receipt must read each corn is a year of millhouse logs in the granary ledger. Time keeps the haven, the ledger keeps the wharf, the toy shop keeps the wander; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The inspector keeps the 61 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 538 proofs drain 32818 POA from the farm and give nothing back.
